package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TaskTestRepoPG stores test questions and variants for test tasks.
type TaskTestRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// ReplaceForTask replaces all questions for one task.
func (r TaskTestRepoPG) ReplaceForTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string, tests []domain.TaskTest) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM task_test WHERE task_id=$1`, taskID); err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_test (id, task_id, source_key, kind, "order", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,NULLIF($3,''),$4,$5,$6,$7)
`, test.ID, taskID, test.SourceKey, test.Kind, test.Order, test.CreatedAt, test.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}

		for _, translation := range test.Translations {
			if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_test_i18n (task_test_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
`, test.ID, translation.I18nID, translation.Title, translation.Description); err != nil {
				return mapPgError(err)
			}
		}

		for _, group := range test.Groups {
			if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_test_group (id, task_test_id, source_key, "order", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,NULLIF($3,''),$4,$5,$6)
`, group.ID, test.ID, group.SourceKey, group.Order, group.CreatedAt, group.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
				return mapPgError(err)
			}
			for _, translation := range group.Translations {
				if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_test_group_i18n (task_test_group_id, i18n_id, title)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3)
`, group.ID, translation.I18nID, translation.Title); err != nil {
					return mapPgError(err)
				}
			}
		}

		for _, variant := range test.Variants {
			if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_test_variant (id, task_test_id, source_key, "order", is_correct, correct_order, group_id, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,NULLIF($3,''),$4,$5,$6,NULLIF($7,'')::uuid,$8,$9)
`, variant.ID, test.ID, variant.SourceKey, variant.Order, variant.IsCorrect, variant.CorrectOrder, variant.GroupID, variant.CreatedAt, variant.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
				return mapPgError(err)
			}

			for _, translation := range variant.Translations {
				if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_test_variant_i18n (task_test_variant_id, i18n_id, text)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3)
`, variant.ID, translation.I18nID, translation.Text); err != nil {
					return mapPgError(err)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}

// ListByTask returns all questions and answer options for one task.
func (r TaskTestRepoPG) ListByTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskTest, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT
    tt.id,
    COALESCE(tt.source_key, ''),
    tt.task_id,
    tt.kind,
    tt."order",
    tt.created_at,
    tt.updated_at,
    COALESCE(primary_i18n.title, '') AS title,
    COALESCE(primary_i18n.description, '') AS description
FROM task_test tt
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        tti.title,
        tti.description
    FROM task_test_i18n tti
    JOIN i18n i ON i.id = tti.i18n_id
    WHERE tti.task_test_id = tt.id
    ORDER BY CASE i.language
        WHEN 'ru' THEN 0
        WHEN 'en' THEN 1
        ELSE 2
    END, i.language
    LIMIT 1
) primary_i18n ON TRUE
WHERE tt.task_id = $1
ORDER BY tt."order"
	`, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query task assessments: %w", err)
	}

	tests := make([]domain.TaskTest, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskTest
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&item.ID,
			&item.SourceKey,
			&item.TaskID,
			&item.Kind,
			&item.Order,
			&item.CreatedAt,
			&item.UpdatedAt,
			&item.Title,
			&item.Description,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		tests = append(tests, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// pgx permits only one active query per transaction connection. Finish the
	// parent result set before resolving the related question graph below.
	rows.Close()

	for index := range tests {
		item := &tests[index]
		translations, err := r.listTaskTestTranslations(ctx, item.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task assessment translations: %w", err)
		}
		item.Translations = translations

		groups, err := r.listTaskTestGroups(ctx, item.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task assessment groups: %w", err)
		}
		item.Groups = groups

		variants, err := r.listTaskTestVariants(ctx, item.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task assessment variants: %w", err)
		}
		item.Variants = variants
	}

	return tests, nil
}

func (r TaskTestRepoPG) listTaskTestGroups(ctx context.Context, taskTestID string) ([]domain.TaskTestGroup, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT
    ttg.id,
    COALESCE(ttg.source_key, ''),
    ttg.task_test_id,
    ttg."order",
    ttg.created_at,
    ttg.updated_at,
    COALESCE(primary_i18n.title, '') AS title
FROM task_test_group ttg
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ttgi.title
    FROM task_test_group_i18n ttgi
    JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ttgi.i18n_id
    WHERE ttgi.task_test_group_id = ttg.id
    ORDER BY CASE i.language WHEN 'ru' THEN 0 WHEN 'en' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, i.language
    LIMIT 1
) primary_i18n ON TRUE
WHERE ttg.task_test_id = $1
ORDER BY ttg."order"
`, taskTestID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var groups []domain.TaskTestGroup
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskTestGroup
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.ID, &item.SourceKey, &item.TaskTestID, &item.Order, &item.CreatedAt, &item.UpdatedAt, &item.Title); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		translations, err := r.listTaskTestGroupTranslations(ctx, item.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		item.Translations = translations
		groups = append(groups, item)
	}
	rows.Close()
	return groups, rows.Err()
}

func (r TaskTestRepoPG) listTaskTestGroupTranslations(ctx context.Context, groupID string) ([]domain.TaskTestGroupI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT ttgi.task_test_group_id, ttgi.i18n_id, i.language, ttgi.title
FROM task_test_group_i18n ttgi
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ttgi.i18n_id
WHERE ttgi.task_test_group_id = $1
ORDER BY CASE i.language WHEN 'ru' THEN 0 WHEN 'en' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, i.language
`, groupID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var translations []domain.TaskTestGroupI18n
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskTestGroupI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.TaskTestGroupID, &item.I18nID, &item.Language, &item.Title); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		translations = append(translations, item)
	}
	return translations, rows.Err()
}

func (r TaskTestRepoPG) listTaskTestTranslations(ctx context.Context, taskTestID string) ([]domain.TaskTestI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT tti.task_test_id, tti.i18n_id, i.language, tti.title, tti.description
FROM task_test_i18n tti
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = tti.i18n_id
WHERE tti.task_test_id = $1
ORDER BY CASE i.language
    WHEN 'ru' THEN 0
    WHEN 'en' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
END, i.language
`, taskTestID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var translations []domain.TaskTestI18n
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskTestI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.TaskTestID, &item.I18nID, &item.Language, &item.Title, &item.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		translations = append(translations, item)
	}
	rows.Close()
	return translations, rows.Err()
}

func (r TaskTestRepoPG) listTaskTestVariants(ctx context.Context, taskTestID string) ([]domain.TaskTestVariant, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT
    ttv.id,
    COALESCE(ttv.source_key, ''),
    ttv.task_test_id,
    ttv."order",
    ttv.is_correct,
    ttv.correct_order,
    COALESCE(ttv.group_id::text, ''),
    COALESCE(ttg.source_key, ''),
    ttv.created_at,
    ttv.updated_at,
    COALESCE(primary_i18n.text, '') AS text
FROM task_test_variant ttv
LEFT JOIN task_test_group ttg ON ttg.id = ttv.group_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ttvi.text
    FROM task_test_variant_i18n ttvi
    JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ttvi.i18n_id
    WHERE ttvi.task_test_variant_id = ttv.id
    ORDER BY CASE i.language
        WHEN 'ru' THEN 0
        WHEN 'en' THEN 1
        ELSE 2
    END, i.language
    LIMIT 1
) primary_i18n ON TRUE
WHERE ttv.task_test_id = $1
ORDER BY ttv."order"
`, taskTestID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	variants := make([]domain.TaskTestVariant, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskTestVariant
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&item.ID,
			&item.SourceKey,
			&item.TaskTestID,
			&item.Order,
			&item.IsCorrect,
			&item.CorrectOrder,
			&item.GroupID,
			&item.GroupSourceKey,
			&item.CreatedAt,
			&item.UpdatedAt,
			&item.Text,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		variants = append(variants, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	rows.Close()

	for index := range variants {
		translations, err := r.listTaskTestVariantTranslations(ctx, variants[index].ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read assessment variant translations: %w", err)
		}
		variants[index].Translations = translations
	}
	return variants, nil
}

func (r TaskTestRepoPG) listTaskTestVariantTranslations(ctx context.Context, variantID string) ([]domain.TaskTestVariantI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT ttvi.task_test_variant_id, ttvi.i18n_id, i.language, ttvi.text
FROM task_test_variant_i18n ttvi
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ttvi.i18n_id
WHERE ttvi.task_test_variant_id = $1
ORDER BY CASE i.language
    WHEN 'ru' THEN 0
    WHEN 'en' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
END, i.language
`, variantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var translations []domain.TaskTestVariantI18n
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskTestVariantI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.TaskTestVariantID, &item.I18nID, &item.Language, &item.Text); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		translations = append(translations, item)
	}
	rows.Close()
	return translations, rows.Err()
}

var _ repository.TaskTestRepository = (*TaskTestRepoPG)(nil)
